_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#4. The existing heat::0 fixture already checks the string-subscript TypeError; this one maps the WHOLE dict-like surface, measured on skfem 12.0.1: dv['left'] -> TypeError "'DofsView' object is not subscriptable"; dv.keys() and dv.get() -> AttributeError "'Dofs' object has no attribute 'keys'" (note the message names Dofs, not DofsView); 'left' in dv -> TypeError "argument of type 'DofsView' is not iterable"; iter(dv) likewise. len(dv) DOES work and returns the DOF count, which is what makes the object look mapping-like in the first place.
